cards.card_text: King David himself walks behind Abner's funeral bier.
cards.verse_text: Then David ordered Joab and all the people with him, “Tear your clothes, put on sackcloth, and mourn before Abner.” And King David himself walked behind the funeral bier.
cards.snippet: …and mourn before Abner.” And King David himself walked behind the funeral bier.

cards.card_text: They lay him on a bier full of spices and blended perfumes, and they make a great fire in his honor.
cards.verse_text: They laid him on a bier that was full of spices and various blended perfumes; then they made a great fire in his honor.
